en: Black‑and‑white view of a European hillside residential district with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century apartment villas. A broad, bright street runs from the foreground into the background, flanked by multi‑storey stone townhouses on the right and freestanding mansions on the left. In the center, a steep stairway or funicular line climbs between buildings up a terraced slope planted like vineyards, with larger villas at the top of the hill. There is a handwritten white label partly covering the bottom left of the image and some small handwritten marks along the bottom edge.
